expectedBehavior: isISO6346 only accepts fully-anchored ISO 6346 IDs (3 owner letters plus U/J/Z category and digits, with comma not a valid category), rejecting IDs with extra prefix or suffix characters.
rationale: The regex /^[A-Z]{3}(U[0-9]{7})|([J,Z][0-9]{6,7})$/ anchors ^ only to the U branch and $ only to the J/Z branch, and [J,Z] includes a comma. Valid IDs pass, but ABCU1234560XYZ (suffix), GARBAGEJ123456 / XXXXZ1234567 (prefix), and ABC,123456 / ,123456 (comma) incorrectly return true on the buggy code and must be false.
reason: the repository's own imports are not directly executable by Node without a build step (extensionless specifiers)
